notes: Use the metro with a Nol card (Red Line from the airport to the Marina); taxis are cheap and reliable (Careem/Uber). The E100 bus to Abu Dhabi costs 25 AED.
November to March is ideal at 20-28°C, good for the beach, the desert and being outdoors. Evenings are cool, so bring a cardigan.
Mosque visits require long sleeves and a headscarf; an abaya is provided at Sheikh Zayed. Alcohol is served only in licensed hotels and restaurants.
Burj Khalifa sunset tickets sell out weeks ahead, as do Museum of the Future tickets.
Old Dubai is cheap and authentic: an abra costs 1 AED and a kebab at Al Ustad 60 AED; Downtown and the Marina are expensive.
A 10% tip is common; haggling in the souks is a must, so start at half the price.

transit.name: Nol Card
transit.why_chosen: Valid on the metro, tram, buses and abra; the Silver card is the most practical.
transit.coverage: Dubai Metro, tram, RTA otobüs, su otobüsü, abra
transit.where_to_buy: Metro istasyonları; 25 AED (6 AED bakiye dahil)

stops.name: Dubai Mall
stops.tips: The world's largest mall, with an aquarium window and an ice rink. An air-conditioned start.

stops.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
stops.tips: A tunnel aquarium inside the mall; watch the sharks.

stops.name: Social House Dubai Mall
stops.tips: International menu with fountain views; lunch.

stops.name: Burj Khalifa At the Top
stops.tips: Floors 124-125; sunset slot (~219 AED). Book tickets online weeks ahead. You get the sunset and the city lights in one visit.

stops.name: Dubai Fountain
stops.tips: The fountain show on Burj Lake runs every 30 minutes; watch it free from the Souk Al Bahar terrace.

backups.name: Time Out Market Dubai
backups.tips: A food market in Souk Al Bahar; lunch with plenty of choice.

backups.name: Sky Views Observatory
backups.tips: A glass walkway facing the Burj; a fallback if Burj tickets are sold out.

days.theme: Old Dubai: Al Fahidi, abra and souks

stops.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
stops.tips: Stone houses with wind towers; have breakfast at Arabian Tea House and stop by the coffee museum. Cool in the morning.

stops.name: Dubai Museum Al Shindagha
stops.tips: Pearl-diving history and a Creek museum in Shindagha; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Dubai Creek Abra
stops.tips: Cross to Deira by wooden boat for 1 AED; Dubai's cheapest and loveliest moment.

stops.name: Deira Spice Souk
stops.tips: Spices, saffron and incense; haggling is a must, and half the asking price is normal.

stops.name: Al Ustad Special Kabab
stops.tips: Iranian kebabs since 1978; in Bur Dubai, with walls full of photos. Dubai's most famous budget restaurant.

backups.name: Arabian Tea House Al Fahidi
backups.tips: Emirati breakfast or lunch in a courtyard.

backups.name: Deira Gold Souk
backups.tips: The gold market; a window-shopping stroll next to the Spice Souk.

stops.name: Kite Beach
stops.tips: A free sandy beach with views of the Burj Al Arab. Sunbeds cost 50-100 AED, and the sea is 22°C in winter.

stops.name: Jumeirah Mosque
stops.tips: The only mosque tour open to non-Muslims (10:00 and 14:00, SMCCU); architecture and a Q&A.

stops.name: Al Fanar Restaurant Jumeirah
stops.tips: A 1960s-themed Emirati restaurant; try the machboos (spiced rice with meat) and luqaimat (sweet dumplings).

stops.name: Madinat Jumeirah Souk
stops.tips: A man-made souk with canals; the abra ride costs 100 AED, with a sunset view of the Burj Al Arab.

stops.name: Burj Al Arab Viewpoint
stops.tips: Sunset views of the Burj Al Arab from Jumeirah Beach; free.

backups.name: Pierchic Madinat
backups.tips: A restaurant on a pier over the sea; a special evening.

backups.name: Etihad Museum
backups.tips: The museum of the UAE's founding; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Dubai Marina Walk
stops.tips: A marina promenade among the skyscrapers; coffee.

stops.name: The View at The Palm
stops.tips: An observation deck on the 52nd floor of Palm Jumeirah; this is where you see the palm shape.

stops.name: Nakheel Mall
stops.tips: The Palm's mall; an air-conditioned break.

stops.name: Bu Qtair Jumeirah
stops.tips: A fishermen's shack turned legend; fried fish of the day, eaten standing or on a stool.

stops.name: JBR The Walk & Beach
stops.tips: The JBR seafront strip; swim in winter, take an evening stroll in summer, with views of Ain Dubai.

backups.name: Marina Social Dubai
backups.tips: A modern menu in the Marina.

backups.name: Ain Dubai
backups.tips: The world's largest observation wheel; if it is open.

stops.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
stops.tips: A garden of 150 million flowers (open November to April); cool in the morning.

stops.name: Global Village
stops.tips: Country pavilions and street food (October to April).

stops.name: Ravi Restaurant Satwa
stops.tips: Pakistani cuisine; Dubai's most famous budget restaurant. The dal and chicken karahi are good.

stops.name: Lahbab Desert Safari
stops.tips: 4x4 dune bashing over red dunes, camels, sunset, a BBQ and a show; hotel pickup included, 250-400 AED.

backups.name: Al Mallah Satwa
backups.tips: Lebanese shawarma and fruit cocktails; an alternative to Ravi.

backups.name: Al Qudra Lakes
backups.tips: Artificial lakes and flamingos in the desert; go by car instead of the safari.

stops.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
stops.tips: 1.5 hours from Dubai (E100 bus, 25 AED). It holds the world's largest carpet and chandeliers; entry is free, online registration is required, and an abaya is provided at the entrance.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
stops.tips: Jean Nouvel's rain-of-light dome; on Saadiyat Island, air-conditioned.

stops.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Cafe
stops.tips: Lunch at the museum cafe, beneath the dome.

stops.name: Qasr Al Watan
stops.tips: The presidential palace; white marble and a library.

stops.name: Abu Dhabi Corniche
stops.tips: A seafront promenade; the return bus leaves at 18:30.

backups.name: Emirates Palace Le Café
backups.tips: Gold-flecked cappuccino in the palace hotel.

backups.name: Ferrari World Yas Island
backups.tips: The world's fastest roller coaster; an alternative to the palace.

stops.name: Alserkal Avenue
stops.tips: An art gallery district in Al Quoz; coffee and free exhibitions.

stops.name: Karama Market
stops.tips: Souvenirs and textiles; haggle.

stops.name: Logma Boxpark
stops.tips: A modern Emirati cafe; regag bread (thin Emirati flatbread) and karak tea, a farewell.

stops.name: Dubai Metro Red Line Airport
stops.tips: Take the metro to DXB Terminals 1-3; goodbye.

backups.name: Karak House Jumeirah
backups.tips: Karak tea and Emirati breakfast; a light farewell.

backups.name: Jameel Arts Centre
backups.tips: Contemporary art on the Creek; an alternative to Alserkal.
